info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Disbursement Management API
info.description: The Disbursement Management API enables businesses to update or modify existing disbursement records within the operational banking services. By using this endpoint, financial institutions can efficiently manage disbursement details, allowing changes to be made to disbursement amounts, recipient information, or statuses. This API is essential for banking operations and is typically utilized by financial institutions, payment processors, and customer service teams to ensure accurate and timely disbursements. Users can make precise updates to specific disbursement transactions identified by unique IDs.
